decision.reasoning_trace: The browsing session was disappointing due to a significant portion of the product feed consisting of accessories like carrying cases and charging cables rather than speakers. Within the consideration set of actual speakers, I found that the high-end options like the Ultimate Ears MEGABLAST ($245) and iHome Smart Speaker ($72) had notable complaints regarding their Alexa integration and connectivity stability. While the Bang & Olufsen and Bose speakers are reputable, their high price points were difficult to justify given the mixed reviews on value. The mid-range options either lacked brand trust or had concerns about longevity, leading to a decision to defer the purchase.
